Is Cheryl Reeve the greatest to ever do it?

Five Coach of the Year awards.

More than Popovich. More than Belichick. More than any coach in major American pro sports history.

Minnesota Lynx's head coach Cheryl Reeve owns 3 Olympic gold medals, 4 WNBA titles, and 5 State Street Investment Management SPY WNBA Coach of the Year honors.

Minnesota Lynx head coach Cheryl Reeve just won her fifth State Street Investment Management SPY WNBA Coach of the Year Award. The WNBA says that's the most by any coach in major American pro sports history.

And she's still stacking up milestones:
- Four WNBA championships
- Three Olympic gold medals
- 397 wins, the most in WNBA history
- Inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame
- Two WNBA Basketball Executive of the Year awards
- A 66% career regular-season winning percentage, higher than Gregg Popovich's
